claims.text: The deviation is established on this trip's own measurement. The booked optimum is 9.0 km (trip_record, routing-engine-v3.2, CTE then Bukit Timah Rd, LTA snapshot 14:10), and the governing actual distance is the trace figure, 12.2 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events — POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km from the threshold test because it is a rounded copy of the same measurement. The excess is 3.2 km, or 35.56% of optimal, and it clears both limbs of the POL-RD-01 gate: 3.2 km is above the 0.8 km absolute floor and 35.56% is above the 20% proportional floor. The route deviation is ESTABLISHED, not merely alleged.

The three artifacts that carry the finding describe the same trip, so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged: TRP-00308 appears on the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown, and the trace window (first fix 2026-08-10T14:14:40, last fix 14:35:40) matches the recorded start and end of the trip to the second. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, so the additional-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 (four or more claims with one or fewer substantiated) is not engaged and the excess may be taken from the trace alone.

The trace is clean for policy purposes and nothing in POL-RD-07 assists the driver. It carries 127 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval across the whole active window, 100% coverage, no gaps, and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. It therefore fails every limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) — no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m, no sustained sampling interval above 30 seconds — so the deviation may be established on the trace alone, the corroboration requirement in POL-RD-07(ii) is not in play, and no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) arises.

No rider instruction can reduce the excess. The chat log for this trip holds no messages at all (message_count 0, first and last message timestamps null, not truncated), so POL-RD-04(a) cannot be satisfied by any message, no chat_message.waypoint_hint exists for the 200 m corroboration test, and the clause is simply unavailable — the test cannot be run on this record. There is no 'stop at Jurong Point first' and no 'take the AYE, not the PIE' here, and the 3.2 km of excess stands unexcluded.

No advisory on file can excuse the excess, and I disclose the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires: EV-ADVIS-00308-01 is MISSING, has no payload, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING, 'No advisory covers the CTE or Bukit Timah Rd in this window'). Because no advisory names a road the optimal route traverses and none carries a validity window, the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run at all, and under POL-RD-13 an external-cause assertion tested against an absent advisory carries no weight. In any event the driver asserts no traffic cause — his answer is the fare model — so nothing in the bundle reduces the measured excess.

Nor is there any adjusted baseline to retreat to. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are null, so POL-RD-05 has no re-quote to re-apply and the booked 9.0 km optimal stands as the baseline; and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and there is no co-rider collection or set-down distance to exclude from the excess. On this record no exoneration route under POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 or POL-RD-12 is open.

The burden has shifted to the driver under POL-RD-08, and his answer — 'Fixed price trip. Whatever route, she paid what she was quoted.' — cites no evidence ID and does not deny either the 12.2 km actually driven or the 9.0 km optimum. A general assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight, and an upfront-quote defence goes to the remedy under POL-RD-11, not to whether the route deviated. On the route question this record is unanswered: the driver does not contest the distance, only the tariff.

I will not ask the tribunal to refund money the policy does not provide, and the rider's claim is not overstated. This was an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: the rider was billed 9.0 km and 14.0 minutes, exactly the optimal figures, for a quoted fare of 15.27 — the same figure as the 15.27 charged, with no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge (the trip does not originate at an airport), and a zero waiting-time fee. Under POL-RD-11 the distance-and-time refund route is closed and the arithmetic in limb (a) yields 0.00. What the rider asks is that the deviation be found on this trip's own clean trace, as POL-RD-01 requires, and that the driver's uncited 'whatever route' assertion be recorded as an answer that fails on route and distance rather than as a denial of the finding.

claims.text: This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip and the rider is already whole on it: fare_breakdown.fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE and quoted_fare_sgd is 15.27, and the ledger records the charged total as 15.27 as well, so the amount charged over the quote is 0.00. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however large the excess on the trace. The rider's request for a refund 'proportionate to the extra distance' is not a remedy this policy provides.

The meter itself confirms the rider was billed on the booked optimal route, not on the route driven: the fare ledger charges 9.0 km and 14.0 minutes, which are exactly trip_record.optimal_distance_km and optimal_duration_min, while the trace records 12.2 km over 21.0 minutes. The extra 3.2 km and extra 7 minutes the rider complains of were never billed to her at all, which is why on this fare model the detour moves no money between the parties.

On the rider's own figures the deviation is ESTABLISHED but not MATERIAL. The excess is 3.2 km, being 35.56% of the 9.0 km booked optimal: that clears the 20% and 0.8 km establishment gates of POL-RD-01, and I do not contest establishment, but it is below both materiality gates of 50% and 8.0 km. No FULL_REFUND uplift in place of a partial is therefore available, and on an upfront-quoted trip the excess does not move money in any event.

The POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern check does not help the rider. On the only two fields that clause permits - driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d - the driver records 0 flags against 260 completed trips in the trailing 90 days, far below the 3-flag test and the 5%-of-40-trips test, and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a different field that may not be substituted for the trailing-window figure. No pattern is established, so limbs (a), (b) and (c) of POL-RD-06 are all unavailable.

Nothing in the pass-through layer generates a correction either. The fare ledger carries no ERP gantry lines at all, airport_surcharge is 0.00, waiting_time_fee is 0.00 and there is no promo or surge line in dispute, so properly chargeable items under POL-RD-09 total 0.00 and the POL-RD-11(a) remedy - charged_total less quoted_fare_sgd less the properly chargeable lines - comes out at 0.00 on the platform's own arithmetic.

This is a decidable case and does not need a human reviewer: the trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 127 fixes at a 10 second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met and POL-RD-10(2), (3) and (5) are not engaged. There is no data failure here that would turn the rider's failure on the money into an escalation.

No external traffic cause is asserted by anyone, so the absent advisory decides nothing. The driver's answer is a fare-model answer, not a 'the road was closed' answer. I disclose that the advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00308-01 is MISSING, has no payload and carries weight 0.0; because no party cites it as the excuse for a measured deviation, POL-RD-03 is not invoked and neither POL-RD-13(1) nor POL-RD-10(5) fires on it.

The rider's prima facie case shifts the burden to the driver, and the driver discharges it with a specific artifact and a specific clause rather than a general assertion: POL-RD-11 on the fare ledger EV-FARE-00308, which shows a quote of 15.27 against a charge of 15.27. Nothing is invoked against an artifact that is missing from the pool, so the driver's answer is a proper answer under POL-RD-08.

Separately, the driver is owed compensation under the second limb of POL-RD-04: the fare ledger shows the rider was billed for 9.0 km while the trace records 12.2 km, a shortfall of 3.2 unbilled kilometres, which exceeds the 1.0 km minimum. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 2.40, already a multiple of 0.05 and well inside the SGD 15.00 cap. The limb is discretionary ('may be granted') and I put it no higher than that; but because driver compensation is a payment to the driver that is independent of, and is never netted against, any amount owed to the filing party, POL-RD-11's bar on recovering the driver's cost FROM THE RIDER does not reach a platform-funded compensation payment.

ruling.explanation: Both parties: this dispute turns on an upfront-quoted fare, and the fare stands. To the rider — the route finding is yours; the money is not. Measured on the governing trace figure (EV-GPS-00308, trace_distance_km 12.2 km, the field POL-RD-01 makes govern over the rounded trip_record copy) against the booked optimum (EV-TRIP-00308, optimal_distance_km 9.0 km), the excess is 3.2 km, or 35.56%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (above 0.8 km and above 20%): the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is below both materiality gates (50%, 8.0 km), so it is not MATERIAL and no POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral follows. The trace is clean for policy purposes: 127 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) is not met, the independent-corroboration rule in POL-RD-07(ii) is not engaged, and POL-RD-10(3) does not escalate. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00308) holds no messages, so no rider instruction under POL-RD-04 exists, no waypoint corroboration can be run, and none of the 3.2 km is excluded; no amendment re-quote exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12), so the booked 9.0 km optimal is the baseline. The advisory EV-ADVIS-00308-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), but no party asserted an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked and neither POL-RD-13 nor POL-RD-10(5) reduces the excess or escalates. On the money: EV-FARE-00308 shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE and quoted_fare_sgd 15.27 with charged_total 15.27, so charged_over_quote is 0.00. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess. There are no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge (the trip does not originate at an airport) and waiting_time_fee 0.00, so the POL-RD-11(a) pass-through correction is also 0.00. Your request for a refund proportionate to the extra distance is not a remedy this policy provides on an upfront-quoted trip and is declined; the charged fare of SGD 15.27 stands. To the driver — your statement that she 'paid what she was quoted' is correct on the money and the fare stands, but the counterparty statement cites no evidence ID and does not deny the 12.2 km driven or the 9.0 km optimum, so it does not answer the route question; the deviation is established on this trip's own trace. Your separate request for DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 2.40 (3.2 unbilled km × SGD 0.75, rounded to the nearest 0.05, within the SGD 15.00 cap) under the second limb of POL-RD-04 is declined. POL-RD-11 governs upfront-quoted trips and provides that the loss on an unjustified detour falls on the driver: the driver's unrecovered cost on an unjustified detour is not recoverable, and the POL-RD-04 compensation route is for a rider-requested detour, which this was not — the chat log is empty and no traffic advisory supports the route taken. No compensation is granted. No referrals issue. POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct review is not triggered: on the only two fields that clause permits, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 260, below the 3-flag test and the 5%-of-40-trips test, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and is not substituted for the trailing-window figure. POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity does not fire, as there are no ERP or surcharge lines at all. The ruling moves SGD 0.00, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, and executes automatically. This is a provisional automated ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 through the help channel within 30 days. Confidence 0.9: the deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-FARE-00308, EV-GPS-00308, EV-TRIP-00308), and the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0 carries no deciding fact.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your reading of the route is borne out, but the fare model leaves nothing to refund. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00308 records 12.2 km over 21.0 minutes against a booked optimum of 9.0 km over 14.0 minutes (EV-TRIP-00308). That is an excess of 3.2 km, or 35.6% of the optimum, which passes both POL-RD-01 gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED — I accept the establishment claims from both sides. It is not MATERIAL: 3.2 km is under 8.0 km and 35.6% is under 50%. Nothing exonerates it: the chat log EV-CHAT-00308 is empty (message_count 0), so there is no rider instruction under POL-RD-04; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so POL-RD-05 has no re-quote; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 gives no matched-itinerary baseline; and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00308-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so with no party asserting an external traffic cause POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-13, an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight. The finding nevertheless moves no money, because this was an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip. EV-FARE-00308 shows quoted_fare_sgd 15.27 and charged_total 15.27, with distance_charged_km 9.0, no ERP gantry lines, airport_surcharge 0.00 and waiting_time_fee 0.00. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and your remedies are limited to the amount by which the charge exceeds the quote plus properly chargeable pass-through lines: 15.27 - 15.27 - 0.00 = 0.00. There is no pass-through correction under POL-RD-09 and no billing-integrity defect. The deviation is found and recorded on the case; the refund is zero. To the driver: your statement that 'whatever route, she paid what she was quoted' answers the tariff, not the distance — it does not deny 12.2 km driven against a 9.0 km optimum, and an assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Your claim for DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 2.40 under the second limb of POL-RD-04 is rejected. The arithmetic is right as far as it goes — distance_charged_km is 9.0 against a 12.2 km trace, a 3.2 km shortfall above the 1.0 km minimum, and 3.2 x SGD 0.75 = SGD 2.40, inside the SGD 15.00 cap — but POL-RD-11 governs an upfront-quoted trip: the detour costs the rider nothing on the distance and time lines and 'the loss falls on the driver', and the clause reserves POL-RD-04 compensation for a detour the rider requested ('where the detour was rider-requested it is compensated under POL-RD-04 instead'). No rider instruction appears in the chat log for this trip, so this is an unjustified detour and its cost is not recoverable.
